purpose: Express a necessity using a spoken contraction.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
なくては → なくちゃ; often omit いけない.
I have to go home now.
I have to study for the exam.
We will not make it unless we hurry.
formation: なくては → なくちゃ; often omit いけない.
restrictions: A sentence-final なくちゃ commonly implies an obligation.
mistake: It describes needing to act, not forbidding the action.
